mutations.name: factory-config-set skips the expectFrom comparison and overwrites a hand edit
mutations.find: if (!isDeepStrictEqual(current, op.expectFrom)) return { outcome: "moved", currentValue: current ?? null };
kills: factory-config-set answers moved on a hand edit after prepare and leaves the bytes unchanged

mutations.name: factory-config-set writes a result that fails FactoryConfigSchema
kills: factory-config-set leaves the file byte-identical and writes no backup when the result fails FactoryConfigSchema

mutations.name: factory-config-set keeps no backup of the old bytes
kills: factory-config-set writes the backup, the revision line and the new file, and the ref reads the new value

mutations.name: factory-config-set ignores its own done row on a replay
kills: factory-config-set answers already on a replay whose ledger has done, and writes nothing more

mutations.name: factory-config-set leaves its temp file behind when the rename throws
kills: factory-config-set leaves the old file whole when the write throws between the temp file and the rename
